description: Is this address well formed for this chain, and what is its EIP-55 checksummed form? Free: deterministic address format check for EVM chains (EIP-55 checksum: valid, checksummed form, whether the input checksum was correct, all lowercase or all uppercase) and Solana (base58, 32 bytes). No external calls. 60 calls/min per client. Format only; says nothing about who controls an address.

chain.description: Chain id or name: an EVM chain (e.g. base, ethereum, eip155:8453) or solana

name: check_address_format
